identity.title: Separate execution errors and not-run samples in the evaluation confusion matrix

origin.summary: The 2D-027 task requires evaluation statistics to distinguish quality judgments from execution errors and samples that were not run.

state.current_summary: 2D-027 is implemented through the existing batch outcome and Run History owners. The matrix separates TP/TN/FP/FN from execution errors, not-run rows, and unknown labels; persisted input denominators and legacy fallback are verified.

objective.summary: Provide a confusion-matrix projection for validation results where quality TP/TN/FP/FN, execution errors, not-run samples, and unknown labels are separate and every count reconciles to the input sample count.
constraints: Reuse VisionPipelineBatchOutcomeContract, VisionPipelineBatchRunSummaryStorage, and the existing run-history/Validation Set projection.
Keep raw result records and existing legacy aggregate fields compatible; do not add a new screen, dataset database, qualification system, or Labeling integration.
Treat OK as the positive acceptance class so false accept maps to FP and false reject maps to FN; do not invent accuracy or confidence data without a denominator.
Keep test data and evidence on D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev; do not change Original, release, deploy, hardware, or external systems.

criteria.text: A four-cell TP/TN/FP/FN matrix is derived from explicit expected/actual outcomes, with execution errors, not-run samples, and unknown labels reported in separate counts.
The accounted count equals the persisted input sample count for full and partial runs; zero denominators render N/A instead of 0%.
The existing run-history projection exposes the matrix without changing raw result records, and focused contract/build checks cover save/reload-compatible legacy data.

evidence.observation: Debug focused confusion-matrix contract passed 3/3: four-cell TP/TN/FP/FN, execution error/not-run/unknown label reconciliation, zero-denominator N/A, and save/reload projection.
Release focused confusion-matrix contract passed 3/3 with the same classification and persisted-denominator coverage.
Owner map, positive-class definition, persisted input denominator, legacy fallback, separate error/not-run/unknown counts, N/A rate rule, and unverified WPF boundary are recorded.

events.summary: Keep VisionPipelineBatchOutcomeContract and Run History projection as the single owner; persist only the input denominator needed to distinguish partial-run not-run rows.
All 2D-027 criteria are satisfied by the Debug/Release focused contracts, save/reload evidence, and documented owner path.
